title: Maple Leaf Cement raises sales in 2026 financial year
summary: Maple Leaf Cement raises sales in 2026 financial year
body_markdown:
###### Tools


- [Print](https://www.globalcement.com/news/21178-maple-leaf-cement-raises-sales-in-2026-financial-year?tmpl=component&print=1&layout=default&page=)


**Pakistan:** Maple Leaf Cement reported sales of US$307m in the 2026 financial year, up by 24% year-on-year. Profit after tax grew to US$45.4m, up by 9% from first-half 2025 financial year levels.
